proposal.rationale: The baseline forms readable replies but retrieves incorrect current and previous locations, and answers missing-object questions confidently. Adapt the shared text representation and evidence attention using original plus reworded versions of the same teaching histories. Keep decoder and readout weights fixed to test a bounded repair of evidence handling rather than rewriting the sentence generator. The same numerical update will be fitted separately from OAK-loaded and Python-loaded parameters; this is one shared decision, not independent agent trials.
